premium_rule: balanced plus the multi_az_handling multiplier_x2 uplift on lines not already multi-AZ; baked_in, intrinsic and n/a lines get none
optimized_rule: balanced minus the mid-point commitment discount from references/vendored/estimate/commitment-discount-ranges.json (rates.compute_savings_plan.rate, rates.database_savings_plan_provisioned.rate; min of the plan rate and service_caps for a capped service; a Database Savings Plan line must also pass the vendored generation_gate), computed per eligible line, each line's discount rounded to whole dollars half-to-even, then summed and subtracted from balanced

aws_services: Amazon EventBridge Scheduler + ECS on Fargate RunTask

database_savings_plans._comment: ElastiCache qualifies only for the Valkey engine; a Redis OSS exception is Database-SP-ineligible and its line is unchanged. A provisioned line is eligible only when its recorded class passes the vendored generation_gate (Generation 7 or newer).
